# DemandMatch

> DemandMatch matches your inventory with your customers' demand, automatically. Software for distributors of chemicals, plastics and industrial goods with $1bn+ in revenue: more sales, better margin, and your sales team only approves.

DemandMatch is sales software for B2B distributors of chemicals, plastics and industrial goods with at least $1bn (about €1bn) in annual revenue, founded in Berlin by Bing Cai and Richard von Waldow.
It reads the systems a distributor already runs (ERP such as SAP, Oracle, Odoo or DATEV; CRM such as HubSpot; the inbox; messengers) read-only, and matches inventory with customer demand in both directions:

- Demand finds stock: for every request from email, phone or CRM it finds the right material, warehouse and margin and prepares the offer.
- Stock finds demand: for overstock and inbound goods it finds the customers who buy exactly that and prepares a personal message for each.

A person in sales approves everything before it goes out. Companies start with a free fit check, then a value assessment and a 30-day pilot on their real data. Contact: hello@demandmatch.io.

## Pricing

All prices net (excl. VAT in Europe, excl. sales tax in the US). Every paid step is credited in full to the next one.

- Fit check (30 minutes): Free
- Value assessment (3 weeks): €20,000 / $22,000
- Pilot (30 days): from €60,000 / $66,000
- License, per year: €90,000 / $99,000 base for the first company with its ERP (€30,000 / $33,000 for each further one) plus 15% of the annual value measured together in the value assessment and the pilot, conservative case only, never more than a third of that value. Setup €60,000 / $66,000 one-time (€20,000 / $22,000 for each further company).
- We measure together. Before the pilot we write down how things run today, and how we calculate. Both sides sign. We measure on your data, in your systems.
- Only the conservative case counts. Whatever comes on top stays with you. Freed sales time never goes into the price.
- The price is fixed for a year. No monthly billing by effect, no arguments over attribution, a budget you can plan. Year one counts half the value, because the ramp-up takes time.
- We measure again at every renewal. If the value rises, the share rises with it. If it falls, your license falls too, never below the base.
- You keep at least three times what you pay. If the license would be more than a third of the value, we cut it. If a third does not cover the base, we tell you in the fit check that it is not a fit yet.
- Every license includes: matching both ways, offers with margin, freight and your pricing rules, read-only connection to ERP, CRM and inbox, and nothing goes out without your team's approval.
- Paid annually in advance, 12-month minimum term. The value assessment and the pilot are credited in full.
- Business case calculator: https://demandmatch.io/en/#roi
